Gazyva/Gazyvaro becomes the first and only therapy to receive FDA approval for this disease, having previously been granted Breakthrough Therapy Designation. A chronic autoimmune disease that can lead to kidney failure, pMN carries a substantial human and economic burden for patients, caregivers and health systems alike.1,2 Proteinuria is a key indicator of kidney damage characterised by high urine protein levels.
